mapper.select: SELECT DATE(r_date) AS dt, -- 날짜 (yyyy-MM-dd) SUM(CAST(r_price AS SIGNED)) AS total -- 그 날 총합 FROM receipt_tb WHERE r_u = #{value} GROUP BY DATE(r_date) ORDER BY dt

SELECT YEARWEEK(r_date, 1) AS yearWeek, -- 202548 형식 MIN(DATE(r_date)) AS weekStart, MAX(DATE(r_date)) AS weekEnd, SUM(CAST(r_price AS SIGNED)) AS total FROM receipt_tb WHERE r_u = #{value} GROUP BY YEARWEEK(r_date, 1) ORDER BY yearWeek
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, -- 2025-12 SUM(CAST(r_price AS SIGNED)) AS total FROM receipt_tb WHERE r_u = #{value} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ym
SELECT u.u_gender AS gender, SUM(CAST(r.r_price AS SIGNED)) AS total FROM receipt_tb r JOIN user_tb u ON r.r_u = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_gender ORDER BY u.u_gender
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(daily_sum), 0) FROM ( SELECT DATE(r_date) AS dt, SUM(CAST(r_price AS SIGNED)) AS daily_sum FROM receipt_tb WHERE r_u = #{value} GROUP BY DATE(r_date) ) t
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(daily_sum), 0) FROM ( SELECT DATE(r_date) AS dt, SUM(CAST(r_price AS SIGNED)) AS daily_sum FROM receipt_tb GROUP BY DATE(r_date) ) t
